description: List Actions configuration variables (${{ vars.NAME }}) with their values. Pass owner + repo for a repository variable, owner + repo + environment for an environment variable, or org for an organisation variable (organisation variables need an admin-scoped token). Admin of the repository or organisation only. Paged: limit (≤100, default 30) / offset. Mirrors GET …/actions/variables. Returns {scope, total, limit, offset, nextOffset, variables:[{name, value, createdAt, updatedAt}]}.

owner.description: Repo owner — username or organisation slug (omit when passing org)

name: gluecron_list_variables
